name: Deleting a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Deleted' email to every admin
description:
Objective: Deleting a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Deleted' email to every admin.
Preconditions: Configured test credentials and the fixture data defined by the test are available.
Steps:
1. Sign in as an admin and read the active Admin/Superadmin users.
2. Create, deactivate and delete a QA-owned permission set.
3. Check the notification portal for PERMISSION_SET_DELETED naming that set.
Expected: The set is gone and every active admin other than the one who deleted it receives PERMISSION_SET_DELETED naming the set (product confirmed 20 Oct 2026).
